question:
Simplify.

 (sin 8theta cos theta - sin 6theta cos 3theta)/( cos 2theta cos theta - sin 3theta sin 4theta)
solution:
**Given:**

 (sin 8theta cos theta - sin 6theta cos 3theta)/( cos 2theta cos theta - sin 3theta sin 4theta)

**Concept Used:**

2sin A cos B = sin(A + B) + sin(A – B)

2cos A sin B = sin(A + B) – sin(A – B)

2cos A cos B = cos(A + B) + cos(A – B)

2sin A sin B = cos(A – B) – cos(A + B)

sin C – sin D = 2cos ((C+D)/(2)) sin ((C-D)/(2)) 

cos C + cos D = 2cos ((C+D)/(2)) cos ((C-D)/(2)) 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Multiply both numerator and denominator by 2,

⇒ (2sin 8theta cos theta - 2sin 6theta cos 3theta)/( 2cos 2theta cos theta - 2sin 3theta sin 4theta)

⇒ Using the identities, we get

⇒ ([sin(8theta + theta)+sin(8theta -theta)]-[sin(6theta + 3theta)+sin(6theta - 3theta)])/([cos(theta + theta)+cos(2theta -theta)]-[cos(3theta - 4theta)-cos(3theta + 4theta)])

⇒ (sin9theta + sin7theta -sin9theta -sin3theta)/(cos3theta + costheta-costheta +cos7theta)

⇒ (sin7theta -sin3theta)/(cos3theta+cos7theta)

⇒ Using half-formula identities, we get

⇒ (2cos(frac{7theta + 3theta)/(2)) sin((7theta - 3theta)/(2))}{2cos((3theta + 7theta)/(2)) cos((3theta - 7theta)/(2))}

⇒ (2cos 5theta sin2theta)/(2cos5theta cos(-2theta))

⇒ (sin 2theta)/(cos 2theta) = tan 2theta

**Therefore, the simplified value of the expression is tan 2theta.**
